create_VisionTransformer: create a VisionTransformer model with configurable patch size, embed dim, depth, and number of heads
build_beit_base_model: build a BEiT base model with patch16 and 224x224 input size for image classification
build_beit_large_model: build a BEiT large model with patch16 and 512x512 input size for high-resolution image classification
test_Attention: test the Attention module with relative position bias for windowed self-attention computation
review_Block: review the Block module that combines attention, MLP, layer norm, and stochastic depth
